# Night of Mischief Event: New New Rewards 2025

![Night of Mischief Event: New New Rewards 2025](/uploads/378_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**[Update 08/26/2025]** Period and notice no more costume **[Update 07/26/2025]** Event back on PTS; New title & beer mug

**The event was initially deactivated on the PTS and not again on September 3rd. come into the live version.
[Update August 15, 2024]**

[Update August 15, 2024]

The long-missed **Night of Mischief** event was back on the PTS and will be making its way into the game this time! Unfortunately, the event was shut down in 2019 due to seemingly unresolvable errors. Now, 5 years later, Night of Mischief has been completely overhauled and repositioned in Skyline Valley. The event now takes place in the **Rapidan Camp** and there are lots of new rewards.

### Event period:

- **October 7, 2025 (6:00 p.m.) - October 21, 2025 (6:00 p.m.)**

![Rapidan Camp (Night of Mischief)](/uploads/nukaknights-post-mischiefnight-20240715082053-1-crop.jpg) 

## Process

The event will once again be led by the eye bot "JES-2R". Outside the event, you can find JES-2R in the north-east of Appalachia at Freddy's Scary House. You can already find it there on the live servers.

The event starts on the hill at Rapidan Camp. Everything in the camp is decorated for Halloween. Next to the statue you will find a red box with costumes if you don't have a costume on hand.

| ![Night of Mischief: Starting Point](/uploads/nukaknights-post-mischiefnight-20240715082313-1.jpg) | ![Put on costume](/uploads/nukaknights-post-mischiefnight-20240715082218-1.jpg) | 

~~"Wear a costume to accelerate progression and receive unique rewards," the event description reads. So it's best to prepare a costume beforehand.~~ You can read about everything that counts as a costume here: Costumes: What counts? A complete list.

**Note:** A costume is no longer required for the event.

Now it's a matter of following the eye bot "JES-2R", lighting the campfires down the hill, blowing up fireworks and eliminating the lost ones (who are dressed in costumes). The bar “Sow Chaos in the Woods” fills up until the task is completed.

| ![Night of Mischief](/uploads/nukaknights-post-mischiefnight-20240711220406-1.jpg) | ![Fireworks](/uploads/nukaknights-post-mischiefnight-20240715082654-1.jpg) | 

Now you have arrived in Rapidan Camp and are given the new task: blowing things up, looting the candy bowls, spraying graffiti on the wall and working on the lawn. Again there is a progress bar with "Sow Chaos on the Grounds of Camp Rapidan."

| ![candy bowls](/uploads/nukaknights-post-mischiefnight-20240715084546-1.jpg) | ![Rapidan Robot](/uploads/nukaknights-post-patch62-mn2-lost.jpg) | 

The eye bot “JES-2R” will now guide you further. “Sow chaos on the cliffs” is the inscription on the last progress bar. Again you have to blow things up, loot the candy bowls and fight the Rapidan robots.

The final takes place at the Vertibird landing site. The Vertibird is now blown up and the last campfire is lit and a 3* Aggressotron is fought. Then the event is successfully completed and you receive your reward.

| ![JES-2R on Vertibird](/uploads/nukaknights-post-mischiefnight-20240715100602-1.jpg) | ![Night of Mischief Finale at Vertibird](/uploads/nukaknights-post-mischiefnight-20240711220753-1.jpg) | 

## Rewards

- 400 XP
- 50 bottle caps
- Three out of 15 foods:
 - Chewing gum
 - Cotton candy bites
 - Gummy candies
 - Pumpkin pie
 - Pumpkin
 - Sweet cake
 - Sugar bombs (with radiation)
 - Corn
 - Yum-Yuim-Russian eggs
 - Potato chips
 - Fancy Lads Cake (with radiation)
 - Sugar bombs
 - Crispy Honey
